```{python}
import html
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
import requests
import yaml
from IPython.display import HTML, display
from itables import init_notebook_mode, show

API_BASE = "https://api.github.com"
HOST_REPOSITORIES_PATH = Path(".github/host-repositories.yml")
CODEOWNERS_CANDIDATE_PATHS = ("CODEOWNERS", ".github/CODEOWNERS", "docs/CODEOWNERS")
EMAIL_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$")


def github_headers() -> dict[str, str]:
	"""Create request headers for GitHub API calls."""
	token = os.getenv("GITHUB_TOKEN") or os.getenv("GH_TOKEN")
	headers = {
		"Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
		"X-GitHub-Api-Version": "2022-11-28",
	}
	if token:
		headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"
	return headers


def read_host_repositories(path: Path) -> list[str]:
	"""Read host repositories from host-repositories.yml."""
	payload = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) or {}
	hosts = payload.get("hosts", [])
	repositories = [host.get("repository", "").strip() for host in hosts]
	return [repository for repository in repositories if repository]


def build_link(url: str, text: str) -> str:
	"""Build an HTML anchor tag for a table cell."""
	return (
		f'<a href="{html.escape(url, quote=True)}" '
		f'target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">{html.escape(text)}</a>'
	)


def codeowner_link(owner: str) -> str:
	"""Build a link for a single CODEOWNERS entry (GitHub user, team, or email)."""
	handle = owner[1:] if owner.startswith("@") else owner

	if EMAIL_PATTERN.match(handle):
		return build_link(f"mailto:{handle}", owner)

	if "/" in handle:
		org, _, team = handle.partition("/")
		return build_link(f"https://github.com/orgs/{org}/teams/{team}", owner)

	return build_link(f"https://github.com/{handle}", owner)


def format_codeowners(owners: list[str]) -> str:
	"""Format a list of CODEOWNERS entries as linked HTML, or '-' if none."""
	if not owners:
		return "-"
	return ", ".join(codeowner_link(owner) for owner in owners)


def fetch_default_codeowner(repository: str, headers: dict[str, str]) -> list[str]:
	"""Fetch the default (wildcard `*`) owners listed in the repository's CODEOWNERS file."""
	content = None
	for path in CODEOWNERS_CANDIDATE_PATHS:
		response = requests.get(
			f"{API_BASE}/repos/{repository}/contents/{path}",
			headers={**headers, "Accept": "application/vnd.github.raw+json"},
			timeout=30,
		)
		if response.ok:
			content = response.text
			break

	if content is None:
		return []

	for line in content.splitlines():
		stripped = line.strip()
		if not stripped or stripped.startswith("#"):
			continue
		pattern, *owners = stripped.split()
		if pattern == "*" and owners:
			return owners

	return []


def fetch_open_pull_request_count(repository: str, headers: dict[str, str]) -> int | None:
	"""Fetch the number of open pull requests for a repository."""
	response = requests.get(
		f"{API_BASE}/repos/{repository}/pulls",
		params={"state": "open", "per_page": 100},
		headers=headers,
		timeout=30,
	)
	if not response.ok:
		return None
	return len(response.json())


def fetch_latest_release(repository: str, headers: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[str, str]:
	"""Fetch the latest release tag name and URL for a repository."""
	releases_url = f"https://github.com/{repository}/releases"
	response = requests.get(
		f"{API_BASE}/repos/{repository}/releases/latest",
		headers=headers,
		timeout=30,
	)
	if response.status_code == 404:
		return "-", releases_url
	if not response.ok:
		return f"API {response.status_code}", releases_url

	release_data = response.json()
	return release_data.get("tag_name", "-"), release_data.get("html_url", releases_url)


def fetch_repository_row(repository: str, headers: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[dict[str, str], list[str]]:
	"""Fetch a summary row of metadata for a single host repository."""
	errors: list[str] = []

	repo_response = requests.get(f"{API_BASE}/repos/{repository}", headers=headers, timeout=30)
	if not repo_response.ok:
		errors.append(f"{repository}: failed to fetch repository details (HTTP {repo_response.status_code})")
		return {
			"Repo": repository,
			"Default codeowner": "-",
			"Open issues": "-",
			"Open PRs": "-",
			"Release version": "-",
		}, errors

	repo_data = repo_response.json()
	repo_html_url = repo_data.get("html_url", f"https://github.com/{repository}")
	total_open_issues_and_prs = repo_data.get("open_issues_count", 0)

	open_pull_requests = fetch_open_pull_request_count(repository, headers)
	if open_pull_requests is None:
		errors.append(f"{repository}: failed to fetch open pull requests")
		open_pull_requests_display = "-"
		open_issues_display = "-"
	else:
		open_issues_count = max(total_open_issues_and_prs - open_pull_requests, 0)
		open_pull_requests_display = build_link(f"{repo_html_url}/pulls", str(open_pull_requests))
		open_issues_display = build_link(f"{repo_html_url}/issues", str(open_issues_count))

	release_tag, release_url = fetch_latest_release(repository, headers)

	row = {
		"Repo": build_link(repo_html_url, repository),
		"Default codeowner": format_codeowners(fetch_default_codeowner(repository, headers)),
		"Open issues": open_issues_display,
		"Open PRs": open_pull_requests_display,
		"Release version": build_link(release_url, release_tag),
	}
	return row, errors


headers = github_headers()
repositories = read_host_repositories(HOST_REPOSITORIES_PATH)

all_rows: list[dict[str, str]] = []
errors: list[str] = []

for repository in repositories:
	row, fetch_errors = fetch_repository_row(repository, headers)
	all_rows.append(row)
	errors.extend(fetch_errors)

if not all_rows:
	all_rows = [
		{
			"Repo": "-",
			"Default codeowner": "-",
			"Open issues": "-",
			"Open PRs": "-",
			"Release version": "No host repositories configured",
		}
	]

table_df = pd.DataFrame(
	all_rows,
	columns=["Repo", "Default codeowner", "Open issues", "Open PRs", "Release version"],
)

token_notice = ""
if not (os.getenv("GITHUB_TOKEN") or os.getenv("GH_TOKEN")):
	token_notice = (
		"<p><strong>Note:</strong> Rendering without a GitHub token may be rate limited.</p>"
	)

error_html = ""
if errors:
	joined = "".join(f"<li>{item}</li>" for item in errors)
	error_html = f"<details><summary>API warnings</summary><ul>{joined}</ul></details>"

if token_notice or error_html:
	display(HTML(f"{token_notice}{error_html}"))

init_notebook_mode(all_interactive=True)
show(
	table_df,
	allow_html=True,
	paging=True,
	pageLength=25,
	order=[[0, "asc"]],
	column_filters="header",
	classes=["display", "compact", "stripe", "hover"],
	columnDefs=[
		{"targets": [2, 3], "width": "1%", "className": "dt-nowrap"},
	],
)
```
